scope: CPU-only immutable source topology/skin and own-clip geometric screening, not native shadow diagnosis

idle.sample_mode: all imported integer frames, no render

walk.sample_mode: all imported integer frames, no render

run.sample_mode: all imported integer frames, no render

jump.sample_mode: all imported integer frames, no render

limitations: Topology weld is performed only on a disposable in-memory BMesh; source geometry remains split at UV/normal seams.
Open boundaries and coincident/non-manifold faces are source-quality observations, not proof of native shadow artifacts.
Own clips are sampled at every imported integer frame; Unreal blends, actor motion, attached props, lighting, shadow maps and renderer are not reproduced.
No renderer setting or production asset is changed.

All skin weights are numerically valid; this does not prove every assignment is anatomically optimal. Some short edges stretch up to 20.325 times rest during jump, while all gross length-plus-stretch flags are zero; subtle cloth/facet deformation is not ruled out.
Blender bone-shape helper is an importer-only hidden collection object, not a retained source mesh or native imported FBX component.

The separate native plunger/prop, hidden-caster flags, native material sidedness, blended poses and shadow sampling are outside source-topology diagnosis; consult sibling NativeSidednessAudit.json for readback.

blender_only_helper.name: Icosphere
blender_only_helper.reason: Blender glTF importer creates a bone custom-shape icosphere in a collection hidden in viewport and render; raw GLB has only char1 mesh node. FBX import has only char1.

validation.topology_comparison: FBX and GLB match vertex/triangle counts, weight stats, raw and copy-weld topology counts.
validation.gross_skin_screen: No evaluated edge simultaneously exceeds 0.15 m and 8 times its rest length; no coincident split pair separates by any measured amount. This is a bounded outlier screen, not full skin-quality acceptance.

native_context.concern: Detached triangular/dotted ground-shadow fragments in native selected stop/jump/landing/recover frames around 4.2–6.4 s.
native_context.image_scope: Selected static contact sheet only; no continuous playback or reproduction.
native_context.peer_review: merge_review read-only code/import audit: source GLB doubleSided true; native M_Crew sidedness not explicitly set by importer; separate RightHand CrewProp remains. Capture hidden-background checks do not read bCastHiddenShadow. None establishes cause.

verdict.conclusion: No obvious stray source geometry or gross skin discontinuity was found that explains the native fragments. Open/non-manifold source topology remains a quality limit; renderer, prop, sidedness and shadow-sampling contributions remain untested by this CPU audit.
